app.name: Oromia Digital Sports Hub
app.tagline: One regional ecosystem. A foundation for every recognised sport.

shell.offline: Offline — changes will sync when connected
shell.pendingSync: {count, plural, =0 {Nothing to sync} one {# change waiting to sync} other {# changes waiting to sync}}

home.title: Welcome
home.intro: Choose a workspace to begin. Records, approvals and reports you can see depend on your role, organisation, sport and territory.

proto.notSaved: Prototype: changes stay on this page only and are not saved.

cc.title: Regional command centre
cc.intro: Decisions and incomplete evidence first. Every figure shows its definition, source, coverage and date.

coverage.label: Federations onboarded
coverage.definition: Recognised federations with an active workspace ÷ federations in the approved register.

participants.label: Unique registered participants
participants.definition: Distinct people with an active dated affiliation. Not enrolments or attendances.

competitions.label: Competitions with validated results
competitions.definition: Completed in-scope competitions whose results are validated ÷ completed competitions.

facilities.label: Facilities with verified use
facilities.definition: Facilities reporting verified use this period ÷ facilities in the register.

fed.intro: Records, competitions and obligations for this federation only.
fed.notBuilt: This sport's operational screens are built in Milestone 5. Shared registry screens are shown here.

athlete.clearanceNote: Only the status is shown. Medical and safeguarding details stay with authorised professionals.
athlete.sportScopeNote: Affiliations are dated and separate per sport. A club change in one sport does not change eligibility in another.

entries.title: Entry review
entries.intro: The system checks the approved rules and flags issues. An authorised registrar decides every failed or uncertain check.
entries.decideAllFirst: Decide every flagged member before accepting the entry.

results.title: Result
results.name: Name
results.correctionNote: A correction never overwrites. It creates a new version and keeps the original with the reason.
results.segregationNote: Submitted by the official, validated by a different technical reviewer, published by the competition manager.
results.placeholderReason: e.g. protest upheld by disciplinary committee

plans.title: Plans awaiting decision
plans.intro: Federation annual plans submitted to the Bureau. Returning a plan requires a reason; the federation resubmits a new version.
plans.financeNote: Budget figures are references for approval. The official ledger stays in the finance system.

dashboard.toAct: {count, plural, =0 {No requests waiting for you} one {# request waiting for your decision} other {# requests waiting for your decision}}
dashboard.nothing: Nothing to show for your role yet.

federations_recognised.label: Federations recognised
federations_recognised.definition: Recognised federations ÷ federations in the register.

clubs_recognised.label: Clubs, academies and schools recognised
clubs_recognised.definition: Organisations with an approved recognition decision.

unique_participants.label: Unique active participants
unique_participants.definition: Distinct people with an active dated affiliation (not enrolments).

duplicates_open.label: Possible duplicates to decide
duplicates_open.definition: Flagged person records awaiting a registrar's decision.

competitions_validated.label: Competitions with validated results
competitions_validated.definition: Available when the competitions module is in use.

facilities_verified_use.label: Facilities with verified use
facilities_verified_use.definition: Available when the facilities module is in use.

submission.segregation: You cannot decide on a request you submitted or already approved at an earlier step.

register.doneBody: The federation registrar will verify the identity and affiliation.
register.duplicatesFlagged: {count, plural, one {# possible duplicate flagged for the registrar} other {# possible duplicates flagged for the registrar}}
register.scopeNote: You can register people only into organisations you are assigned to.

person.merged: Marked as the same person as an earlier record
person.masked: Some details are hidden for your role.
person.scopeNote: Affiliations are dated and separate per sport.

orgs.submittedBody: The federation secretariat will review and decide.
orgs.recognitionNote: Recognition is decided by the federation; the system records the decision.

duplicates.intro: The system flags possible duplicates. A registrar decides, with a reason. Records are never merged automatically.

users.passwordRule: At least 12 characters with letters and digits. Share it securely.
users.grantNote: You can grant only roles your own role allows, inside your own scope.

account.title: My account
account.rule: At least 12 characters with letters and digits.
account.mfaStep1: Add this key to an authenticator app, then enter the 6-digit code it shows.
account.mfaIntro: Protect your account with a code from an authenticator app.

errors.email_taken: A user with that email already exists.
